en.headline: Police arrest five over copper taken from closed Shek Lei Pui plant
en.dek: Officers detained four men on suspicion of burglary and a recycling-shop operator over parts valued at about 350,000 dollars.
body: Police have arrested five men over the theft of copper parts from the disused Shek Lei Pui water treatment works in Golden Hill, Sham Shui Po.

The Water Supplies Department reported between July and September that doors and locks at the closed plant had been damaged, and copper wire together with 48 copper pump components, valued at about 350,000 dollars, were missing. Officers from the Sham Shui Po district crime unit said closed-circuit footage, including cameras under the Sharp Eyes scheme, pointed to a group that sold the parts to a recycling shop in the district.

On Wednesday police arrested a local man and three Vietnamese men aged 25 to 45 who were on recognisance papers, on suspicion of burglary, and a 55-year-old local man who ran the recycling shop, on suspicion of handling stolen goods. All five were detained for investigation. The case is being followed by the district's crime support team.
The Water Supplies Department said the plant stopped operating in 2021, the parts had already been discarded, and the theft did not affect the water supply.

zh.headline: 石梨貝濾水廠銅件被盜 警拘五人包括回收店負責人
zh.dek: 警方指，已停用的金山石梨貝濾水廠銅線及四十八個銅製水泵部件被盜，損失約三十五萬元，供水未受影響。
body: 警方拘捕五名男子，涉嫌盜去深水埗金山已停用的石梨貝濾水廠銅製部件。
警方表示，七月至九月期間接獲水務署報案，指濾水廠門及門鎖被破壞，多組銅線及四十八個銅製水泵部件不翼而飛，損失約三十五萬元。深水埗警區刑事部及特遣隊翻查閉路電視，包括「銳眼計劃」鏡頭後，相信有人將部件售予區內一間回收店。
周三，警方在深水埗拘捕一名本地男子及三名持行街紙的越南籍男子，年齡介乎二十五至四十五歲，涉嫌爆竊；同時拘捕一名五十五歲本地回收店負責人，涉嫌處理贓物。五人正被扣留調查，案件由深水埗警區刑事支援隊跟進。
水務署表示，濾水廠自二零二一年起停止運作，相關零件已廢棄，事件沒有影響供水。
